# Pinned Smeltery opening sources

These files are copied unchanged from Tinkers' Construct
`f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2`:

- `src/generated/resources/data/tconstruct/advancements/smeltery/structure.json`
- `src/main/java/slimeknights/tconstruct/shared/inventory/BlockContainerOpenedTrigger.java`

https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/tree/f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2

The manifest records paths and SHA-256 hashes. The native advancement changes
only the icon item key. The trigger adapter supports the Smeltery block-entity
type and delegates player predicates/progress to the native host pipeline.
